r9_scope.root_cause: The observed r8 failure was a Legacy hostproxy/native listen-target mix-up: the HOST path sent Legacy's local proxy target to authority IPC while Payload Config.Port/ExternalPort remained the native game listen settings, producing authority_port_mismatch. The actual remote proxy port was not captured in the user log; synthetic fixture values are excluded from the hardware observation.
implemented: Separate the HOST native authority endpoint from the Member/proxy room target.
For HOST only, pass explicit -port and -external launch settings from the native game listen endpoint; Member remains endpoint-only.
Validate the native authority ACK against the same HOST endpoint.
Use the same HOST target configuration and ACK validation during refresh.
Use the VNT HOST virtual address before member endpoint publication; remove the dependency on an endpoint that native startup must first publish; still fail preparation when VNT is unavailable.
Preserve the named-pipe cause while sanitizing secrets.

rules: All 52 breakpoints receive an r9 append record; unaffected items are NOT_REEVALUATED_R9.
The earlier r7 installed Payload mismatch is historical context only and is not an r9 blocking condition.
Test counts are read from r9/rust-final-v2/execution-receipt.json; every observed failed and ignored count must be zero.
The initial r9 format-only failure is retained with zero tests run and is never counted as a pass.
Source and evidence hashes are computed from raw bytes; runtime PE patterns are marked binary by .gitattributes.
Backend and Payload remain unchanged; no new deployment or CI pass is claimed.
The exact-commit GitHub Actions/checks lookup is NOT_RUN; local tests do not substitute for CI.
Native authority admission and the three-machine matrix remain NOT_RUN and cannot promote release_ready.
